projects.title: use-shortcut
projects.summary: A tiny (~1KB), zero-dependency, fully-typed React hook for keyboard shortcuts. Cross-platform mod (⌘/Ctrl), array bindings, input skipping, element-scoped listeners, scoped providers, and always-fresh callbacks — no stale closures.

projects.title: TimeLens
projects.summary: A privacy-first Manifest V3 Chrome extension that tracks where your time goes online and classifies it by intent (Learning, Work, Entertainment…) instead of just by domain. A fast deterministic ruleset handles common cases while on-device Gemini Nano refines ambiguous pages — and nothing ever leaves the browser: no telemetry, no cloud, no history permission.

projects.title: Crossify
projects.summary: A geolocation-based community platform where people create and run interest 'clubs', host real-world events, and chat in moderated rooms. As the backend developer I built the Express/MongoDB REST APIs, role-based access for creators, moderators and members, Socket.io real-time chat rooms, and location-aware club/event search.

projects.title: DevTools Playground
projects.summary: An ad-free, privacy-first suite of 8 developer tools (JSON formatter, JWT decoder, regex tester, cron parser…) behind a Cmd+K palette — all running client-side, no login or database. Tool state is encoded in the URL hash so links are shareable but never sent to a server, with one optional streaming AI endpoint that explains regex/cron/JSON. Every keyboard shortcut runs through my own npm package, use-shortcut.
